families.notes: Family page = 172 HE (high-efficiency pump) models: 22 part numbers (3-13 outlets, each with an 'IN' inverted row). The 'IN' suffix is described in a note, but each IN code is its own row in the part-number table, so they are variants (not options). Variant size = the 3/4" NPT connection; outlet count is the differentiator (additional_specs). 01155_NA (2 pp, 172 series tech data, written for the 3-speed UPS 15-58 version) = spec_sheet; its family-level values (brass, 150 psi, 195°F inlet) agree with the page. temperature_range = primary inlet max (rating); control range 80-130°F (page + sheet) kept in additional_specs (mixing-valve precedent). material_body = mixing valve unit/manifold body brass (pump body cast iron is a component). NA11011 Revit content guide = other_doc (instructions for BIM files, not the product); Idronics 7/16 design journals = other_doc. Page shows '3D models bim' but no CAD file link in the packet -> cad empty. 'hydronic distribution systems'/'floor radiant panels' map to no applications term.
